reason: Extends temporary law keeping municipal inspectors' delegated enforcement powers (assisting police against violence) alive; prevents lapse, preserving and expanding enforcement capacity.
Anchors administrative detention up to six months and movement restrictions in permanent law under Public Security minister, decoupled from emergency; safeguards added but powers broadened.
Mandates security forces take any action, including firing weapons, against Gazans entering a widened one-kilometre buffer zone; expands use-of-force discretion.
